meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能用Vercel命令行工具把网页应用部署到线上，部署前会检查代码构建，部署后会验证网址是否可访问；也能管理Vercel项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当被要求将网页应用上线到Vercel，或管理Vercel项目、域名等时。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到Vercel生产环境。
say.note: Claude会先运行构建，再执行部署并检查状态。

say.text: 把环境变量MY_KEY添加到生产环境。
say.note: Claude会用你提供的值创建该变量。

say.text: 帮我把example.com域名添加到项目。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel via CLI, check builds, verify live URLs, and manage projects, domains, and env vars.
howto.when_en: When asked to put a web app live on Vercel, or manage Vercel projects, domains, etc.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude will build and deploy, then check the URL.

say_en.text: Add env variable MY_KEY to production.
say_en.note: Claude will create it with the value you provide.

say_en.text: Add domain example.com to the project.
say_en.note: Claude will run the domain add command.
